chunks.title: Spring Boot MySQL Dockerfile
chunks.content:
Spring Boot MySQL Dockerfile

Multi-stage Dockerfile for Spring Boot with MySQL. Build stage: maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17. Runtime stage: eclipse-temurin:17-jre. Supports JAVA_OPTS env variable for JVM tuning. ENTRYPOINT uses sh -c to expand $JAVA_OPTS at container startup.

Decision rules:
- Use when language=java, framework=spring_boot, dependencies include mysql
- JAVA_OPTS pattern allows tuning heap/GC flags without rebuilding the image

Trade-offs:
- sh -c entrypoint adds a shell process but enables env var expansion in JAVA_OPTS
- No non-root user defined — add USER directive before ENTRYPOINT for production hardening

Anti-patterns:
- Do not hardcode MYSQL_PASSWORD or connection URL in the Dockerfile
- Do not use a JDK image in the runtime stage
